testo:
■ Whenever one of your gacharange creatures that has 2 or more attached auras attacks, you may attach this to that creature from your hand.
■ Whenever the attached creature wins a battle, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your mana zone.
Orega Aura
